title: THE OPEN MIC
hero: mmx image-01 (Folana's cozy radio room, fairy lights, open mic night, community gathered)
description: The first Open Mic night at the Inner Circle. Folana steps back from the microphone to let others be heard. The broadcast becomes a collective — no longer 'her show' but 'our show.' Vulnerable, raw, beautiful. Members share their own frequencies for the first time.
style: Indie folk / Dream pop with acoustic guitar fingerpicking, warm piano, soft strings, gentle percussion, tender female vocals with layered harmonies. Building from intimate verse to soaring anthemic chorus.
